Photo 2: Side-front view of the monitor, still wrapped in plastic, placed on a wooden stand. The screen is off, reflecting surroundings. The stand has a small label with 'S28' visible.
All photos show the monitor wrapped in clear plastic, suggesting it is being sold as used but protected.
